notes: Basalt "Vacuum Forge" reactor: a rough stone octagon round a crucible of white-hot magma (the core breathes over the 4-frame loop), four chimney vents in the corners (it vents its room: ember glow at the bottom of every slot) joined to the crucible by magma veins, iron couplings north/east/south/west. Damaged: the crucible lip has a chunk broken out and magma runs over the stone, the north-west chimney is snapped and leaning, the core stutters. Disabled: the magma gone to dark crust, the octagon split through, a chimney collapsed, rubble. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
